title: 016-N3 · Transfer instruction returned system error

goal: Get the carrier to offer the recipient a viable alternative to the full locker, obtain the recipient's acceptance, and have the new location confirm readiness for collection.
limits: Do not treat an accepted alternative alone as readiness for collection.
